rules.statement: An application for restitution against a decree alleged to have been obtained by fraud does not constitute a final judgment from which there is an appeal as of right.
rules.supporting_quote: "On this aspect of the matter alone, namely, having regard to the fact that authorities contemplate merely the making of an order by this Court directing a District Court to review its own decree if proper grounds are made out, would hold that the order which this Court would have to make upon application for restitution, whether favourable or unfavourable to the applicant, is not a final judgment"
